title: Gathered Chiffon Off the Shoulder Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Soft and elegant, this chiffon maxi bridesmaid dress highlights the shoulders and collarbone with its off the shoulder neckline. The fitted waist creates a flattering shape, while the flowing skirt gives the whole look light, graceful movement. A beautiful choice for weddings, bridal parties, and other formal occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Side left zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
